name: isms-galangan
description: Integrated Shipyard Management System — monorepo (apps/web, services/api)

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix services/api && npm ci --prefix apps/web && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['services/api','apps/web']){const e=d+'/.env',x=d+'/.env.example';if(!fs.existsSync(e)&&fs.existsSync(x)){fs.copyFileSync(x,e);console.log('created '+e)}}"
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix apps/web && npm run check --prefix services/api
